result.keyword: What's the best CRM for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **HubSpot** as the best all-round CRM. However, if your team is primarily focused on winning new business, **Pipedrive** might actually be the better choice.

Here are the five I'd shortlist in 2026.

## Best CRMs for a small team

![21 Best CRM Enterprise Software Reviewed For 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/E3oBllJko6DSkC1G-YxonkpSd-C9EJzphRnffFc13dKq176hHlHIBef_KD3uo3Rj4h1fcldcCQ6woqfNfkWWmNW8Rs1_qiHKjMrnT7yrtNAkkpWII-RvqcBN_-0EERClJKgsbj3AQum9lvjpnXVV_ofvoY4dYvM4uvHF3Aza7RJS9SAW_-O73lSaxuQ1_7Sl?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. HubSpot**

(Best overall)

- Easy to learn and implement
- Contact management, deals and sales pipeline
- Excellent marketing and email integrations
- Free plan available for up to 2 users

Best for teams wanting sales, marketing and customer management together.

[HubSpot website](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm)

---

![Pipedrive Culture | Comparably](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/LL0qs5ZEn5bajHXZMpCmlJ4Q8G8bG-uCRPdMDaugOTZ5M83xr5SdfSJtpaTsU9pV5XZU_j6tdK98aLeb5eQtmf3jAulEyqWXtwu_NCqqantmt4RgTKgW92e5jqAqiwI5Gvz6HoJSFRLf0DV2WCKF0F5we1qdhyYgERFOvFPWSwO__wWT47lukE3R9cSOeuBr?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Pipedrive**

(Best for sales teams)

- Fantastic visual sales pipeline
- Easy to track leads and opportunities
- Follow-up reminders and sales reporting
- Very intuitive interface

Best for teams where salespeople need to manage prospects and close deals.

[Pipedrive website](https://www.pipedrive.com/)

---



**3\. Zoho CRM**

- Excellent value for money
- Lots of customisation
- Workflow automation
- Free plan for up to 3 users

Best for teams wanting flexibility without paying enterprise prices.

[Zoho CRM website](https://www.zoho.com/crm/)

---



**4\. Freshsales**

- Built-in email and phone capabilities
- Sales automation
- Lead scoring
- Affordable entry-level plans

Best for teams wanting communication and sales management in one system.

[Freshsales website](https://www.freshworks.com/crm/sales/)

---

![monday.com Products | Boost Productivity Today — Elevate Operations](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/9pbfxtp9MRSzmGqOOXUT3zYq1fPIuocDylKAQoIzVyuW1Vjc44XoGiROM2GBYduUngwZNPfMFXzqdnmJ1poftmoV-bK85Cp0YYpYmV5sjFjpnjYHjyVWJd9MpDQXQDk0zHwEfS7B57VsWkUtP1cpZQ-ZPXVz1YthngyreHroaIgVKVfnbNj-IFVycI5aW_GQ?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. monday CRM**

- Very visual and customisable
- Sales and project management together
- Good team collaboration
- Flexible workflows

Best for teams managing clients, projects and internal tasks together.

[monday CRM website](https://monday.com/crm)

## My quick comparison

| CRM | Main strength | Starting price\* |
|--------|--------|--------|
| HubSpot | All-round CRM | Free |
| Pipedrive | Sales pipeline | \~US\$14/user/mo |
| Zoho | Value and features | \~US\$14/user/mo |
| Freshsales | Sales communications | \~US\$9/user/mo |
| monday CRM | Workflow management | \~US\$12/seat/mo |


\*Indicative US annual-billing prices, not Australian quotes. Check local pricing, GST and plan limits before purchasing.
